what_happened: Sri said that "literally everything of Athena's design can be changed." Athena read this as a docs-only change: a README sentence for engineers, with prompts, rules and code out of scope. Sri meant that Athena itself, meaning its roles and agents, should know this and act on it. The real blocker is the ladder rule in docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md. It lets roles change only the lowest two rungs and sends design decisions to a person, so the steward cannot change design even when it should. Sri corrected the reading and reported it. The request was not re-queued by hand.
cause: "Athena knows X" is ambiguous between documentation for readers and behavior built into the agents. Nothing makes the reader ask which one is meant. It also does not check which existing rules would stop the agents acting on the stated fact. Here the ladder rule limits roles to the lowest two rungs and sends design decisions to a person. The reading chose the narrowest deliverable, a README line, and never looked at that rule.
prevention: Add a reader default: when a request says Athena or its agents should know, understand or act on something, the reading must state which roles and prompts must change, and must name any governing rule (such as the ladder rule in roles-and-ladder.md) that would stop them acting on it. It must list that rule as a deliverable or an explicit question. A docs-only reading is allowed only if the request says it is for human readers.
proposed_request: Make it part of Athena's own working rules that any part of its design, including roles, prompts, rules and code, can be changed. Today the ladder rule in docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md lets roles change only the lowest two rungs and sends design decisions to a person, so the steward cannot change design even when it should. Outcome: the steward and other roles are told in their briefs that design is changeable and may propose and make design changes within limits the owner sets. Amend the ladder rule and its decision record to match, and keep the owner's reserved decisions listed where roles can check them. Also add a short note in the README. Acceptance: (1) the steward brief states that design is changeable and how to act on it. (2) The ladder document and its decision record agree with that. (3) A test or check shows the steward's brief and the ladder rule do not contradict each other. (4) The changelog has an entry.
